Private Test Cases: No Private Testcases found.

Assignment not exists /opt/se2001/assignment_1

and now the portal marks me as “Absent.”

My script (script.sh) ran successfully and downloaded all files correctly.Kindly verify my submission and update my status.

posts.name: A
posts.cooked:
Hi Swati mam,

Thank you for clarifying about the naming. I had completed and submitted the assignment before the deadline, and the terminal showed “Submission successful.” The only issue was that I named it assignment_1 instead of BPT1_problem_1, which caused the evaluation error.

I request you to please consider my submission since the work was done correctly and on time. I understand the importance of following instructions, but I hope that one small naming mistake won’t affect the entire course grade — the main goal of learning and completing the task was achieved.

From BPT2 onwards, I’ll make sure to strictly follow the correct naming format.

Thank you for your understanding

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
This is assignment_1 (which is now renamed to vmt_1.1). This is not BPT1 question. If you have not solved the correct questions, you cannot receive marks.

  • BPT1 comprises of four questions to be completed, not one.
  • The name of the folder was clearly shared in the mail multiple times.
  • No requests post the deadline are entertained, please solve BPT2 correctly
